Technical SEO.title: WordPress Random Redirects, Branded API Data & CDN Advice - SEO Pulse
Technical SEO.summary: This week's SEO Pulse covers a WordPress random redirect issue, branded data surfacing in the Search Console API, Google's CDN guidance, and questions around who controls bot and agent access. All four topics have direct crawling, indexation, or infrastructure implications for enterprise SEO teams.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Disrupts Its Search Advertising with Its Embrace of AI
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The New York Times reports on how Google's growing AI integration is reshaping its core search advertising business, a development with direct implications for how organic and paid search interact at an enterprise level.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT citation drops look like unannounced Google core updates
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land reports that sudden drops in ChatGPT citation volume are exhibiting patterns similar to unannounced Google core updates, suggesting AI answer surfaces may be applying their own ranking-like volatility without public disclosure.

AI Search / GEO.title: Turkey forces Google to let news sites exit AI Overviews but stay in search
AI Search / GEO.summary: A regulatory ruling in Turkey requires Google to offer news publishers the ability to opt out of AI Overviews while retaining their presence in standard search results, a precedent with potential global implications for how sites control their AI-answer visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: What Actually Gets You Cited in AI Search (2026 Data)
AI Search / GEO.summary: A 2026 data study examines the factors that drive citation in AI-powered search surfaces, offering evidence-based insight directly applicable to GEO strategy for enterprise content teams.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top 20 Domains Cited by LLMs (325K Prompts Analyzed)
AI Search / GEO.summary: An analysis of 325,000 prompts identifies the top 20 domains most frequently cited by large language models, providing a benchmark for enterprise brands assessing their AI-answer surface visibility relative to competitors.

AI Search / GEO.title: 2025 - ChatGPT named 21 competitors and us 0 times. 2026 - Them 0, us 65%
AI Search / GEO.summary: Seer Interactive documents a dramatic year-over-year reversal in ChatGPT brand mention share, moving from zero mentions against 21 named competitors in 2025 to a dominant citation share in 2026, illustrating how GEO efforts can materially shift AI-answer visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: How LLMs Choose Sources to Cite: What the Data Actually Shows
AI Search / GEO.summary: This data-driven piece examines the signals and content attributes that influence which sources large language models select when generating cited answers, directly informing GEO content strategy for enterprise teams.
